entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return an order. Order number is VF-8675309.

Okay, VF-8675309. Let me pull that up. I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Neither. I just don't need it. Can you just process the return please? I don't have all day.

I understand you're busy. I'm just checking the delivery date here... It looks like it was delivered 12 days ago, on January 16th. For the VeloBand Pulse specifically, our policy is a 10-day return window due to how the device activates and for hygiene reasons.
Are you serious? It's two days. Listen, I had a medical emergency. I was in the hospital. I wasn't exactly thinking about your return policy.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope everything is alright now. Of course, that's a different situation. Can you confirm this was a sudden medical issue that prevented the return?

Yes. It was an emergency that required immediate surgery. My upcoming military deployment is now on hold because of it. I have no use for this device for the foreseeable future. So, yes or no, can you process this return?

Yes, absolutely. Thank you for clarifying, and please accept my sincerest apologies for your situation. Given the circumstances involving the hospital stay and surgery, I can definitely make a one-time exception for you. I'm processing a full refund back to your original payment method right now.
Okay. Good. What do I do with the band?

I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email on file. You can just package the item back in its box, attach the label, and drop it with any carrier. The refund will be finalized once we receive it. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
You're very welcome. I wish you a speedy recovery. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good rest of your day.
